about: Sirach is a book of wise teachings from a teacher named Jesus son of Sirach.

pages.title: Honor Your Parents
pages.scene: A child helping an old parent
pages.text: "Children, listen to your father and mother. When you honor them, God hears your prayers. Help your parents when they are old, and be patient with them."

pages.title: A Faithful Friend
pages.scene: Two friends sitting under a tree
pages.text: "A faithful friend is like a strong shelter. Whoever finds one has found a treasure. Nothing is worth as much as a true friend." Be the kind of friend you want to have.
pages.lesson: A true friend is a treasure.

pages.title: Praise God's Works
pages.text: "Look at the rainbow and praise the One who made it! The sun, the moon, the snow, the wind and the sea all do what God says." Everywhere we look, we can see how wonderful God is.
